usedFor: Each new Shopify order is posted to Slack so fulfilment sees it as it arrives.

bestTemplate.name: “New Order” in Shopify, then “Send Message” in Slack
bestTemplate.why: “Send Message” can target a channel, user or thread, so the post goes to whoever packs.

watchOut: Order messages are held for approval before reaching the Slack channel, so plan who watches that queue.
